name: Organic Chocolate Plant Protein
description: A smooth, rich chocolate plant protein for post-workout recovery or an easy protein boost any time of day. Each serving provides 25g of plant protein in a blend designed to mix easily with water or your favourite milk.

name: Vanilla Almond Vegan Protein
description: A creamy vanilla blend with a light almond finish. This vegan protein makes a simple everyday shake and pairs well with smoothies, oats, or a quick breakfast.

name: Strawberry Oat Protein
description: A bright strawberry shake with a soft oat flavour. Each serving delivers 22g of plant protein, with a mellow taste that works just as well blended into breakfast as it does after training.

name: Salted Caramel Protein
description: Sweet caramel flavour balanced with a touch of salt. This vegan blend offers 25g of protein per serving and mixes into a satisfying shake for your daily routine.

name: Banana Cream Protein
description: A mellow banana cream shake with 23g of plant protein per serving. Try it blended with oats or frozen banana for a quick, filling smoothie. Currently out of stock.

name: Daily Greens Meal Shake
description: A vanilla matcha meal shake for busy mornings and between-meal breaks. Each serving contains 20g of protein and blends into a smooth, convenient drink.

name: Peanut Butter Cookie Protein
description: A peanut butter inspired shake with a cookie-like finish. With 26g of vegan protein in each serving, it is an easy option for a post-training drink or a filling smoothie.

name: Berry Breakfast Meal Shake
description: A fruity mixed berry shake made for breakfast on the go. Each serving provides 21g of protein and blends smoothly with water, milk, or your favourite smoothie ingredients.
